name: migration
summary: New command `/migration-sync` — the incremental half of the pack. Every existing command answers "is V2 at parity with V1 as it stands today" by re-reading both trees whole; none of them has a notion of *a V1 change*, so a live V1 that still ships forced a full re-scan per week and could report a difference without ever reporting that a validation rule had been tightened. `/migration-sync` is commit-delta driven: it pulls `v1_root` from `v1_remote`/`v1_branch` (halting on a dirty V1, a detached HEAD, a failed fetch or a non-ff local), computes the commits past the watermark in `ai/migration/sync-state.md`, classifies each as behaviour / refactor-only / dead-v1 / mechanical / needs-full-port, writes an analysis answering what changed + API-or-Web + which rules, validations, DTOs, endpoints and schema moved, extends the existing `ai/migration/mapping/<feature>.md` with a V1-change→V2-implementation table BEFORE any edit, then dispatches the existing `/find-and-fix` / `/port-feature` engines (no second porting path). Completeness is counted as `changes_in == changes_closed` over three buckets only — ported / intentionally-not-ported / deferred — the final audit re-reads the raw V1 diff rather than the analysis, and the watermark advances by contiguous prefix only, never past an unresolved commit. Anchors gain `v1_remote` / `v1_branch` / `v1_sync_state`.
